title: I built a "Choose Your Own Adventure" style game using AI
author: tangerinelights
selftext:
Knocked up a proof of concept at the link below - the real challenge is going to be engineering the right prompts to deliver interesting stories and payoffs to the players. Would love to workshop this with anyone that has experience in the area!

Or feel free to throw out any feature suggestions or feedback - interested to see if people think the concept is viable / enjoyable.

[https://bio.site/aiadventure](https://bio.site/aiadventure)

replies.author: tangerinelights
replies.body: Passwordless sign in isn’t really possible without a phone or email address

replies.author: tangerinelights
replies.body: How would this work if you signed up on desktop and then wanted to pull up your account on mobile?

replies.author: ghost_of_drusepth
replies.body: It wouldn't, but I'd wager the (number of players turned off by having to create an account first) is greater than the (number of players who want to sync a game's progress between devices), especially for something so early-stage.

replies.author: cleroth
replies.body:
Import/export function. Many idle games did this back in the day (maybe still today, I haven't looked).

Not saying email is absolutely terrible, but it does add friction that will prevent some people even trying it.
